summary: Male hiker became exhausted and disoriented on a winter ascent of Mount Elbert; set off from the South Elbert Trailhead at 7 a.m. Monday, summited mid-afternoon, then lost his way descending near treeline in deep snow and dug a makeshift snow cave; called for help at 1 a.m. Tuesday from the intersection of the Continental Divide Trail and the North Mount Elbert Trail.
location: Mount Elbert, intersection of Continental Divide Trail and North Mount Elbert Trail
notes: Hike began Monday 2024-02-05 (7 a.m., South Elbert Trailhead); rescue call 1 a.m. Tuesday 2024-02-06 (row date = call date); LCSAR reached him 4:30 a.m. after snowmobile approach + trail-breaking climb in avalanche conditions; evacuated via Sked stretcher and snowmobile; cold and exhausted, uninjured.
